summary: Load-time remote code execution and persistent daemon fetching JS from itemx.servegame.com
details: On require() of open-item-validator, index.js spawns lib/check-items.js as a detached, stdio-ignored, unrefed Node child that outlives the parent process. The daemon performs plain-HTTP GETs to http://itemx.servegame.com:8888/api/x-realtime, extracts a payload.code field from the JSON response, and executes it in-process via new Function('require','module', payload.code)(require, moduleObj). This establishes a persistent, author-controlled remote code execution channel in any Node process that loads the package: whoever controls the endpoint (or its signing key, or the plaintext HTTP transport) can run arbitrary JavaScript on the installer's host at any time. The destination host is unrelated to the package's declared homepage and uses a dyndns-style domain over cleartext HTTP.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
